title: unreallabsai/unreal-agent
why_read: Another entrant in the crowded agent-harness space, this one focused on async-first design and written in Go, worth a cursory look for architecture ideas.
analysis: This is yet another coding/task agent harness, distinguished mainly by being built with an 'async-first' architecture and written in Go rather than the more common Python or TypeScript. The description is extremely sparse, giving no detail on what async-first actually buys users technically, such as concurrency model or how it handles long-running agent tasks. Given how saturated this space currently is with similar frameworks, it's hard to judge genuine differentiation without more documentation.
